Dataset name: Trees in parks and green areas of Madrid
Dataset brief description: This dataset from the Madrid City Council's Open Data Portal describes trees, their health status, and tree masses (masas arb?reas) located in the districts, streets and historic/singular/forest parks maintained by the municipality of Madrid. Data is provided for multiple years (2017–2025), updated annually, and is published under a CC BY 4.0 license. Dataset metadata is available in RDF format compliant with DCAT-AP-ES.
